title: Bounded Scheduler Code Review
gradingCriteria: Finds the continueOnError catch path leak: active is not decremented and next() is not called, so the promise can hang.
Finds results.filter(Boolean) and if(result) drop valid 0/false/null results.
Finds result order is not preserved because results.push uses completion order, breaking index-to-input mapping.
Finds opts.limit || 4 ignores limit=0 and fails to validate non-finite, negative, or fractional limits.
Mentions abort listener cleanup or in-flight workers continuing after abort as a secondary risk.
Patch strategy uses preallocated results by input index, decrements active in finally/catch, calls next after handled errors, and resolves without filtering.
